lines.item: Feetech STS3215 12 V (ST-3215-C018), all six joints
lines.basis: cited range: Waveshare lists US$16.99-21.99 for its 30 kg.cm@12V / 19.5 kg.cm@7.4V options; the upper figure is taken for the 12 V

lines.item: Waveshare bus servo adapter board (USB to STS serial bus)
PLA filament, 1 kg spool (parts use 322 g at 60% fill)
Fastener kit M2/M2.5/M3 and 1 mm PTFE sheet for the turntable washer

notes: Servo cables come with the STS3215 (assumed, not priced).
The STS3215's rear idler disc is part of the servo, so no idler horn sets are needed.

Shoulder needs 66% of stall with a 150 g payload and safety factor 1.5: over HS's 50% rule; at that rule rev B carries about 63 g. SO-101 runs the same servo class at its shoulder at 80% of its own servo's stall with no payload (same method, its URDF), see docs/DEVICE_REFERENCE_BENCHMARK_20261127.md.
Shipping, tax and lead times not included.
